fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 34% match is a weak fit for this Finance Manager, Technology FP&A role.

**Strengths:**
- Rebuilt forecast model, lifting accuracy from 88% to 96%
- Advanced Excel (INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, VBA) plus Power BI and SAP
- Cut month-end reporting from 9 to 6 days through VBA automation

**Gaps:**
- No M&A deal model review, due diligence, or post-merger integration
- No pricing, margin, unit economics, or discount structure modeling
- No SaaS experience, and no Anaplan or Workday exposure

**Recommendation:** Build pricing and unit economics modeling skills, finish your ACCA papers, and target mid-level FP&A roles at software companies before applying to this manager-level role.

coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Okta

Dear Hiring Manager,

A newly formed organization needs budgets and forecasts people can trust before it has much history to build them on. At Calder Industrial Components I faced a version of that problem: the forecast for our larger business unit was missing the mark, so I rebuilt the model around order backlog and lifted accuracy from 88% to 96%.

That is the work your Finance Manager role puts first: owning budgeting and forecasting, preparing budget vs. actual variance analysis, and partnering with the business on controllable spend. As a Financial Analyst with 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units. I also cut our month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, which gives me a practical view of how FP&A works with the close process. My advanced Excel, Power BI and SAP reporting skills support the financial modeling you need, and I'm studying for my ACCA qualification (9 of 13 papers passed). Your focus on M&A, pricing and enterprise deals is new ground for me, but I learn fast and I like building models from scratch.

I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your Technology organization's planning and process improvement as it scales. I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
